_meta.description: Every input the cost engine is allowed to use. Each carries a source id. Values marked 'assumption' are shown to the reader as assumptions, never as findings.
_meta.rule: A parameter with no source may not be multiplied by an amount to produce a cell. If no official price exists, the corresponding cell stays blank and the method is flagged.

fx.note: The board is a reference table. CN-08 states the rate actually applied at the counter governs. The one-way margin is the right measure for a single CNY-to-USD conversion; the round-trip figure, widely quoted as 'the spread', is twice that and is not the cost of converting once.

boc_personal_wire.note: Commission is charged on the CNY equivalent of the remittance. Because it is capped at CNY 260, the effective rate falls as the amount rises.

correspondent.condition: USD 15 applies where the receiving bank holds its account with BOC's New York branch; USD 25 otherwise
correspondent.assumption: Included in the model as an optional service. A sender who declines full-amount arrival may instead have the correspondent charge deducted from the principal, which is the same economic cost.

receiving_bank.assumption: Named example only: Chase's published fee schedule shows USD 15 for an incoming international wire. Your own bank's inbound fee is not verified and may be zero, as it is for several US account tiers.

quota.note: Annual facilitation quota for individual settlement and for FX purchase by a 境内个人 (Art. 54).

cash.note: USD 5,000-10,000 outbound requires a bank-issued carriage permit; above USD 10,000 a SAFE permit (Art. 89). The model uses the no-permit tier of USD 5,000 per trip.

penalty_cn.note: Art. 39 (evading FX control) and Art. 45 (private or disguised FX dealing): fine up to 30% of the amount, 30%-100% if serious, plus confiscation of illegal gains and criminal referral where the threshold is met. A statutory range, not an assessment of any individual case.

china_iit.note: Flat 20% on transfer of assets and on interest, dividends and bonuses (Art. 3(3)). Charged on the gain or the income, never on the principal.

us_income_tax_2026_single.note: Illustrative statutory computation for a single filer with no other income, taking only the standard deduction. It answers 'what if this were taxable income', which is not the same question as 'what does converting cost'.

us_fbar.note: Willful penalty maximum is the greater of USD 100,000 or 50% of the balance at the time of the violation, per violation. Non-willful is capped at USD 10,000 per violation in the statute and adjusted for inflation in practice.
